Privacy & Cookies

Last updated: 23 January 2026

Who we are

DJ Auto Care Detailing is a mobile car detailing service. This page explains how personal information is handled when you use this website or contact us.

Information we collect

We may collect information you choose to provide when contacting us, such as:

  • Your name
  • Your phone number or email address
  • Details relating to your enquiry or booking

How we use your information

  • To respond to enquiries and provide quotes
  • To arrange and manage bookings
  • To communicate regarding our services

Cookies

This website uses essential cookies required for it to function correctly. We do not use advertising or marketing cookies.

Analytics

We use privacy-friendly analytics (for example via Cloudflare) to understand website traffic and improve the site. These analytics do not identify individual users.

Sharing information

We do not sell or rent personal information. Information is only shared when necessary to provide our services or where legally required.
